requirement_text:
Implement logic and UI support allowing users to resubmit previously rejected applications. Enable the resubmit link/action exclusively for rejected applications while disabling or hiding it for approved applications, allowing admin users to re-evaluate and approve resubmitted applications.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Verify that only applications with a rejected status display an active 'Resubmit' link or button.
- Verify that approved or in-progress applications do not display the 'Resubmit' link.
- Verify that submitting a rejected application updates its state appropriately so that admin users can re-review and re-approve it.
- Ensure existing application submission and approval workflows remain unaffected.

requirements.text: Display an active 'Resubmit' link or button exclusively for applications with a rejected status.
Disable or hide the 'Resubmit' link/button for approved or in-progress applications.
Update the application state upon resubmission to allow admin users to re-evaluate and re-approve it.
Ensure existing application submission and approval workflows remain unaffected.
